support_claim: The registry row for 09338441 names VELLUM PRINT CO LTD and the billing records name Vellum Print Co Ltd, but no observation links the billing referent to that company number.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and name similarity is insufficient; the packet preserves two referents mentioned in separate sources without an observation that the billed entity is company 09338441, so neither SAME_ENTITY nor DISTINCT is licensed.
